content.comment_body: I created a [product_name] project on one computer and transferred it to another computer using a USB drive. When I opened the project, I received a "java.io.StreamCorruptedException" error message. What could be causing this issue?

I'm not very familiar with this topic, but it might be related to Java not being installed on your computer, or a problem with your Java runtime. I suggest visiting www.java.com to download an update. You could also click "help" and check for error messages that might explain the issue. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters a java.io.StreamCorruptedException error after transferring a [product_name] project file between computers. This indicates that compatibility issues or missing software dependencies, such as Java, may disrupt project interoperability and usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to move [product_name] projects between computers seamlessly, without encountering technical errors or compatibility problems.
